items.prep: tail and thin parts removed for even thickness, bones removed, patted dry

instructions: For even thickness, remove the tail and any thin parts of the salmon, and remove any bones.
Sprinkle with the 1 tablespoon kosher salt and refrigerate 1–4 hours.
Set the oven rack 7 inches from the broiling element.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towels, then smear with the honey.
Broil at 500°F for 6 minutes, turning halfway through.
Lower the heat to 250°F and cook 7.5–9 more minutes, turning halfway through, until the internal temperature reaches 125°F. Cover loosely with aluminum foil if it gets too dark.
Meanwhile, make the pesto: blitz the almonds, chili pepper, garlic, and anchovies in a food processor for 15 seconds.
Add the arugula, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt, and blitz 30 seconds more.
Spoon the pesto over the broiled salmon and serve.
notes: Text submission. The salmon quantity was not specified in the source. Anchovies appeared in parentheses in the source; kept as written (kosher fish). The 1–4 hour salt rest is passive, not counted in prep or cook time. Prep estimate reasoning: 5 base + salmon trim/debone 6 + measure salt & refrigerate 1 + pat dry 1 + measure honey 1 + measure almonds 1 + clean chili 1.5 + garlic 1.75 + rinse anchovies 1 + measure arugula 1 + measure oil 1 + measure lemon juice 1 + measure salt 1 + food processor 2 batches 2 + setup/cleanup 3 = 28.25 → 30. Servings anchor: salmon quantity not stated; default 4 for a standard main-course fish recipe.
